messages:
Incident-Bot: ALERT created — high tail latency observed for embedder-v2 embeddings (p99 ~6.8s) across eu-west & us-central at 2523456789
Sam Ortiz: I see it. grabbing traces and flamegraphs now, p99 spike started ~2m ago
Morgan Lee: continuous-batching queue depth spiking. batching_pending_count up x3 on several nodes
Anya Chen: oncall here. dashboards show a small number of routes with ctx_len > 4096 dominating CPU and KV cache pressure
Javier Ruiz: any recent changes? deploy-bot, any pushes in last 30m?
Deploy-Bot: release/emb-config-426 deployed 33m ago by morgan. no rollouts in last 15m
Sam Ortiz: rolling mitigation plan — 1) temporary route-specific rate-limits for ctx_len>2048 2) lower batching delay and tokens to cut tail 3) toggle off prefix_cache for embedder-v2 4) open CS ticket for customer check
Anya Chen: agree. suggest conservative cuts: set max_batch_delay 35ms -> 10ms, max_batch_tokens 8192 -> 4096, and per-route limit 250rps for long ctx. also add quickfilter to reject batched requests with ctx_len>8192
Sam Ortiz: applying rate-limit now: POST /ops/ratelimit {"service":"embedder-v2","matcher":"ctx_len>2048","limit_rps":250} — curl posted
Infra-Oncall: rate-limit applied to route set A :white_check_mark: queues dropping
Morgan Lee: patching batching config: PATCH /ops/batching/embedder-v2 {"max_batch_delay_ms":10,"max_batch_tokens":4096} — rolling to 6 nodes
Sam Ortiz: note: changing batch_delay will influence token-efficiency, expect throughput dip. prepare rollback plan
Javier Ruiz: disabling prefix cache: POST /ops/cache/toggle {"service":"embedder-v2","feature":"prefix","state":"off"}
Sam Ortiz: prefix cache disabled. KV-cache miss rate up from 2% -> 18% on worker-21
Anya Chen: p99 down from 6.8s -> 1.6s within 70s of mitigations. p50 stable. overall qps down ~9% on embedder pool
Product-Ops: flagged potential cost increase for customers with heavy long-context usage. drafting proactive note to top affected accounts
CustomerSuccess-Bot: creating outreach task for top-5 embed customers with large ctx > 2k
Morgan Lee: leaving a quick note: if we need throughput back, we can re-enable prefix cache and relax max_batch_delay to 18ms. but tail latency will increase
Sam Ortiz: taking short-term ownership, will hand off lead to Anya in 8m. I'll stay as secondary
Anya Chen: I will take incident lead on handoff. creating ticket INC-252345-embedder and adding mitigation summary + runbook steps
Javier Ruiz: follow-ups to add to runbook: 1) automated trigger to apply ctx_len rate-limit when queueing > 3s 2) metric for ctx_len distribution per route 3) experiment to shard long-context requests to different pool
Sam Ortiz: note for ops: add canary for re-enable prefix cache at 03:00 UTC with 1 node, measure p99 & throughput for 10m before scaling
Infra-Oncall: canary scheduled in job queue — will not run until manual approval
Product-Ops: sending the customer note now, includes link to status page and expected impact (p99 improved but throughput slightly reduced)
Anya Chen: monitoring window: keep mitigations for now, will consider gradual relax if stable for 30m. scheduling postmortem 48h out
Sam Ortiz: closing live mitigation episode once p99 <1.7s for 10 continuous minutes and batching queues normal across all AZs
Incident-Bot: INCIDENT updated — mitigations applied, status=monitoring, last_update=2523457120
